{{Quote|Hoth's one of the largest starship graveyards in the galaxy. During the war, there was a massive battle in orbit. Dozens of vessels crashed to the surface. Because of the freezing cold, they've remained well-preserved. Some are almost intact.|Jedi Knight [[Leeha Narezz]]|}} The '''Battle of Hoth''' was a major [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] that occurred in [[3665 BBY]], during the second [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A [[Prototype warship fleet|fleet]] of highly advanced prototype [[Warship/Legends|warships]], including the Republic [[superdreadnaught]] ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', was ambushed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] after [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] alerted [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] existence, and the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] became the site of a massive [[Realspace/Legends|space]] battle that lasted for [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. While the battle began along the supposedly [[Secret route through the Hoth system|secret route]] that the Republic fleet was traveling, the conflict passed through several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before reaching its peak above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The final stages of the battle in the Hoth system destroyed over seventy-five [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], inflicting heavy damage on both the Imperial and Republic Navies and sending ships such as the ''Star of Coruscant'', the ''[[Conraddas Vindicator]]'', the ''[[Vehement Sword]]'', and the ''[[Ambria's Fury]]'' crashing to the [[Water/Legends|icy]] surface of Hoth. The Battle of Hoth severely demoralized the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], breaking the momentum generated by the [[Battle of Alderaan|recent victory]] at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and leading to the Republic's eventual acceptance of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ended the war in [[3653 BBY]]. Over fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the battle, the wreckage of the destroyed ships turned the planet's icy surface into a hotly contested [[Ground warfare/Legends|battleground]]. Both the Empire and the Republic [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|battled each other]] and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization in an effort to salvage what they could of the prototype technology lost in the last war. ==Prelude== {{Quote|I was in a remote part of the Outer Rim, where we were escorting a small fleet of prototype warships on what should have been a secret route.|Grand Master Satele Shan recounts the Battle of Hoth|}} In the wake of victories such as the [[Battle of Alderaan]] and a [[Campaign near Gell Mattar|campaign]] under the leadership of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jace Malcom]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began to gather a [[Prototype warship fleet|fleet]] of prototype [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and powerful [[Warship/Legends|warships]], led by the legendary prototype [[superdreadnaught]] ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', with the purpose of eventually attacking the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and ending the [[Great Galactic War]]. However, in [[3665 BBY]], a secret [[Zero Station|Chiss enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] intercepted coded Republic messages indicating the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] existence and that it would soon pass along a [[Secret route through the Hoth system|secret route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The enclave notified [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], as the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] was an ally of the Empire, and the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] gathered near the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. ==The battle== {{Quote|We were forced to abandon the prototype technology we had been assigned to protect.|Grand Master Satele Shan|}} [[File:Star_of_Coruscant.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Star of Coruscant'', the flagship of the Republic fleet, crashed on the surface of Hoth.]] As the Republic fleet passed along the secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]], not far from the uninhabited [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], a massive strike force from the Imperial [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] ambushed the Republic ships. This began a protracted [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] that lasted for [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and spread over several star systems. The presence of the powerful prototype ships ensured the survival of many of the Republic crew members—including [[Satele Shan]], one of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] assigned to protect the fleet—but the battle [[Death/Legends|claimed the lives]] of many on both sides and destroyed hundreds of vessels. The fighting reached its peak in the Hoth system, where over seventy-five vessels were sent crashing to Hoth's surface. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas]], the driving force behind the ''Star of Coruscant'' project, survived most of the battle, but was killed when his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Starbreeze]]'', was shot down over the planet. Republic ships such as the ''[[Sendant Pride]]'' and the [[Deliverance (Republic)|''Deliverance'']] were damaged or destroyed during the battle and succumbed to Hoth's powerful [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]], joining the growing number of ships strewn upon the [[Water/Legends|icy]] surface. The ''[[Vehement Sword]]'', a prototype warship equipped with the newly developed [[Null Cannon]]s—[[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] that fired energy blasts to disable entire starships, similar to large-scale [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]—was another casualty of the conflict, breaking in half upon impact and splintering the Null Cannon prototype into dozens of pieces. The ''Star of Coruscant'' itself crashed onto the planet, but the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught's]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was so strong that the ship remained completely intact, buried in the snow and ice. A [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]], the ''[[Intercessor]]'', escaped the battle and went on to fight in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] ''[[Conraddas Vindicator]]'' was among the casualties as well as a [[Republic transport ship (stealth generators)|Republic transport ship]] that was carrying experimental [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]–designed [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Dauntless Star]]'' shot down over sixty Imperial fighters before being destroyed, while starfighter units such as [[Victor Squadron]] took down dozens of [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]] before they, too, were eliminated. [[File:Conraddis_Vindicator.png|thumb|right|210px|The remains of the ''Conraddis Vindicator'' and a smaller craft on the surface of Hoth]] Many Imperial craft were claimed by the battle as well—the [[Enforcer (Sith Empire)|''Enforcer'']], ''[[Storm Fire]]'', and ''[[Indignation]]'' were among the ships that crashed on Hoth's surface, and an [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|Imperial scientist's]] [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|shuttle]], the ''[[Deference]]'', was also shot down and ended up in the [[Highmount Ridge]] region. Among the more notable casualties were an [[Unidentified Imperial prison ship|Imperial prison ship]] carrying the legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]], who had been [[Defeat of the Starweird Queen|captured]] by the Empire shortly beforehand, and the ''[[Ambria's Fury]]''—a sleek and secretive warship whose loss distressed the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] of the Empire. Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] was shot down in the battle as well, and a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] was believed destroyed during the fighting, though it was actually lost amid the crashed ships.{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Icy Imperial Inroads|Hoth}} ==Aftermath== {{Quote|I remember the reports coming in from Hoth during the war. I was at headquarters when the Republic superdreadnaught went down… the whole room cheered.|Doctor [[Eckard Lokin]]|}} The Battle of Hoth was a heavy blow to the Republic war effort, and, despite the cost to the Imperial Navy, it was considered a victory for the Empire. Many veterans of the Great Galactic War later believed that the engagement was a major turning point in the war and one of the main reasons that the Republic later accepted the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] [[3653 BBY|twelve years]] later to end the war.{{TORcite|type=codex|The Battle of Hoth}} The image of the ''Star of Coruscant'' falling to Hoth's surface was a great tool for Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]], and Omas' death during the battle also spelled the end of the Republic's [[Shadow Arsenal]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] project, though the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] continued to work on the stealth arsenal of planet-cracking [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] in secret. After being shot down, Davos was stranded on Hoth's surface for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before he was rescued. Neither the Republic nor the Empire attempted any recovery or salvage efforts beyond the retrieval of Davos by the Empire, and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from the [[White Maw]] organization took advantage of their disinterest to begin salvage efforts of their own. The ''Star of Coruscant'' became a pirate [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], and it was not until sometime after the Treaty of Coruscant that the Republic and the Empire [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|returned]] to Hoth in order to salvage what they could from the remains of their prototype ships.{{TORcite|type=codex|Salvaging Starships}} Over two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after the battle, Imperial forces recovered the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that had been thought destroyed with help from the Chiss Ascendancy. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Pilot First Class Darkil Aro was shot down during the Battle of Hoth. He's been lost for years out there in the wastelands.|Cedin Kavil, during the cut mission "Survivor"|{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Survivor|Hoth}}}} [[File:Starship_Graveyard_concept.png|thumb|left|300px|Arnie Jorgensen's first concept art of Hoth]] The Battle of Hoth was first mentioned in the entry for Hoth in [[the Holonet]], a section of the [http://www.swtor.com official website] for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.{{Holonet|planets|hoth|Hoth}} [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] reference book is internally inconsistent as to the date of the battle; the initial entry that mentions the battle is dated to 3665 BBY, but in a second later entry dated approximately four and a half years later, Gnost-Dural refers to the battle as having taken place around three years earlier—which would place the battle around [[3664 BBY]] instead. The very first concept art for Hoth by lead artist [[Arnie Jorgensen]] featured the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], and the Graveyard and the Battle of Hoth were elements of the planet's storyline from the beginning of the development process.''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' The cut Republic mission "Survivor" would have featured the player rescuing [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] First Class Darkil Aro, who had crashed during the Battle of Hoth after taking down an Imperial battle cruiser and managed to survive the last two decades amidst the frozen wastes. The [[Imperial Agent]] missions involving the Shadow Arsenal superweapon place the Battle of Hoth near the end of the war, though this is inconsistent with all other sources. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{C|Mentioned only in-game; Codex entry}} ==Sources== *{{HolonetOld|planets|hoth|Hoth}} {{1stm}} *{{TORweb|url=media/concepts/hoth-0|text=Concept Art – Hoth|nolive=1}} *{{Holonet|planets|hoth|Hoth}} *''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' *[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] *''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' *{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20121114|text=Developer Update: Section X and HK-51 Missions in Game Update 1.5}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ---- {{GreatGalacticWarNav}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Hoth (Großer Galaktischer Krieg) |es=Batalla de Hoth (Gran Guerra Galáctica) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Hoth (Great Galactic War), Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Hoth]] [[Category:Battles of the Great Galactic War]]
